purpose: Teach: 独創/船舶/専務/チェックイン/資する/格別/見返り/退任

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 独創的な提案、若手から募れ。
lines.en: I want original proposals. Solicit them from the younger staff.
lines.style: Crisp, direct command. Slight weight on 「独創的」—clarity, not harshness. Measured pace. The certainty of someone accustomed to being heard.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。船舶部門、専務の指導下で進めています。
lines.en: Yes, sir. The shipping division is proceeding under the Senior Vice President's supervision.
lines.style: Professional, attentive. Even delivery—not rushed, not stalling. Respectful without excessive deference. Eyes forward, acknowledgment complete.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 出張先のホテル、チェックイン、早めに。
lines.en: When you're on your business trip, check into the hotel early.
lines.style: Practical instruction, almost incidental. Brief pause before the directive. No elaboration—he trusts it will be understood. Measured, matter-of-fact tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 業界発展に資する提案、社内で集めています。
lines.en: We're collecting proposals internally—ones that will advance the industry.
lines.style: Steady update, measured cadence. Slight emphasis on 「業界発展に資する」—showing he's aligned with the bigger picture. Calm, progress-oriented delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 格別な顧客対応、見返りを求めず、進めろ。
lines.en: Provide exceptional customer care. Do it without expecting anything in return.
lines.style: Firm instruction with underlying principle. Weight on the imperative. Quiet conviction—not lecturing, but drawing a line. Slightly slower on the second clause.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 社長の退任に向けて、後継体制も整えます。
lines.en: We're preparing the successor structure for the President's retirement.
lines.style: Professional assurance, forward-looking. Steady confidence. No apology, no uncertainty—just stating what will be done. Slight lift at the end, closing a thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.style: Final word, deliberately sparse. Pause before speaking. Weight on the phrase—not rushed. The kind of closing that sits with you. Quiet but carrying full authority.
